result.summary: Found 2 minor issues: an accessibility labeling gap and a small styling inconsistency in link sizing.

issues.description: The heart icon (favorite button) on restaurant cards has no accessible text label for screen readers to indicate its purpose.
issues.suggestion: Add an aria-label to each heart icon, e.g., 'Add to favorites' or 'Remove from favorites', to describe its function to assistive technology users.

issues.description: The 'See all' text links are smaller in font size compared to the category filter chips and section headers, creating a minor visual hierarchy inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font size of 'See all' links slightly to align with the visual weight of other interactive navigation elements on the page.
